sql.blueravenCustomField.getOne: select cf.id, cf.list_of_value_id, cf.field_name, cf.archived, cf.created_by_id, cf.modified_by_id, cf.company_data_type_id, coalesce(( select array_to_json(array_agg(rows)) from ( select cot.id as "objectTypeId", cot.object_type as "objectType", cfot.id, cfot.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfot.archived from brs.object_type cot left join brs.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.object_type_id = cot.id and cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id and cfot.archived is not true where cot.archived is not true and cfot.archived is not true ) rows), '[]') AS custom_field_object_types, coalesce(( select array_to_json(array_agg(rows)) from ( select lv.id, lv.name, lv.parent_id as "parentId", lv.date_created as "dateCreated", lv.date_modified as "dateModified", lv.created_by_id as "createdById", lv.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", lv.display_order as "displayOrder", lv.archived from brs.list_of_value lv where lv.parent_id = cf.list_of_value_id and lv.archived is not true order by lv.display_order ) rows), '[]') AS list_of_values from brs.custom_field cf where cf.id = :id order by cf.field_name
sql.blueravenCustomField.getAll: select cf.id, cf.list_of_value_id, cf.field_name, cf.archived, cf.created_by_id, cf.modified_by_id, cf.company_data_type_id, coalesce(( select array_to_json(array_agg(rows)) from ( select cot.id as "objectTypeId", cot.object_type as "objectType", cfot.id, cfot.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfot.archived from brs.object_type cot left join brs.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.object_type_id = cot.id and cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id and cfot.archived is not true where cot.archived is not true and cfot.archived is not true ) rows), '[]') AS custom_field_object_types, coalesce(( select array_to_json(array_agg(rows)) from ( select lv.id, lv.name, lv.parent_id as "parentId", lv.date_created as "dateCreated", lv.date_modified as "dateModified", lv.created_by_id as "createdById", lv.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", lv.display_order as "displayOrder", lv.archived from brs.list_of_value lv where lv.parent_id = cf.list_of_value_id and lv.archived is not true order by lv.display_order ) rows), '[]') AS list_of_values from brs.custom_field cf where cf.archived is not true order by cf.field_name
sql.blueravenCustomField.deleteField: update brs.custom_field set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :fieldId
sql.blueravenCustomField.saveField: update brs.custom_field set field_name = :fieldName, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomField.insertField: insert into brs.custom_field(list_of_value_id, field_name, date_created, created_by_id, company_data_type_id) values (:listOfValueId, :fieldName, now(), :createdById, :companyDataTypeId) returning id
sql.blueravenCustomField.insertListOfValue: insert into brs.list_of_value(name, parent_id, date_created, created_by_id, display_order) values (:name, :parentId, now(), :createdById, (select coalesce(max(display_order) + 1, 0) from brs.list_of_value where parent_id = :parentId and archived is not true))
sql.blueravenCustomField.updateListOfValue: update brs.list_of_value set name = :name, parent_id = :parentId, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, display_order = :displayOrder, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomField.archiveListOfValue: update brs.list_of_value set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomField.updateCustomFieldOb: update brs.custom_field_object_type set archived = :archived, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
